# ghost/geological-timescale

Geological Time Scale (F-Droid): the Earth's geological time scale as a coloured table (eon, era, period, epoch, age) with the start of each unit in million years ago. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/geological-timescale
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/geological-timescale open_timescale --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/geological-timescale get_scale --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/geological-timescale zoom_in --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/geological-timescale zoom_out --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/geological-timescale lookup_unit --device <serial> --param name=<name>
```

## Actions

- `open_timescale`: Open the geological time scale
- `get_scale`: What does the geological time scale show now?
- `zoom_in`: Zoom the geological time scale in to periods
- `zoom_out`: Zoom the geological time scale out
- `lookup_unit`: When did the Jurassic period start?
